notes: Strong separation of services with exclusive in-memory stores and an in-memory EventBus used for inter-service events (task.assigned, task.statusChanged, comment.added). No service directly calls another; the API Router orchestrates interactions and handles all HTTP. Forward-only task status transitions are enforced. All required services, CRUD operations, member management, assignment, status changes, comments, notifications, and a demo script are implemented. Code is clean and well-typed, but HTTP responses for GET by id return 200 with null instead of 404, and duplicate creates throw leading to 500 rather than a more appropriate 409. Input validation is minimal, and the NotificationService design relies on the router to supply assigneeId in comment events (acceptable but a bit fragile). Overall, constraints are fully respected.
